description:
"Over 93% of American adults are metabolically dysfunctional right now, and almost every single one of them walked out of their last doctor visit being told their labs were totally normal."

In Good Energy: The Surprising Connection Between Metabolism and Limitless Health, Dr. Casey Means (former Stanford-trained head and neck surgeon) and Calley Means expose the single hidden crisis driving modern chronic illness: cellular energy failure.

From cancer and Alzheimer's to depression, fatigue, and obesity, 9 of the top 10 causes of death share one common root: broken mitochondria starved of essential micronutrients amidst caloric overload. In this comprehensive deep dive, we break down why standard medical checkups miss insulin resistance for years, the biological science behind the 2:30 PM brain fog slump, how ultra-processed food corrupts cellular code, and the six actionable biomarkers you must measure to take control of your biological agency.
